messages:
Maya: Customer requested temporary 'infra-admin' for troubleshooting their on-prem cluster. We need a checklist before granting.
Ashok: Agree. Must be time-bound (default 8h, up to 24h with sec approval) + approval ticket.
Jordan: What about key access? If infra-admin can trigger services that use KMS-wrapped keys, scope is critical. We should never give direct KMS console access.
Maya: They won't get console/KMS creds. They can call internal service endpoints. We must log every key-use event with caller identity.
Ivan (ops): Operational controls: 1) RBAC TTL enforced by our auth service, 2) approval recorded in Jira link on request, 3) token annotated with approver and expiry, 4) post-expiry reconciliation job.
Remy: SIEM: forward structured events and netflow. For air-gapped sites provide a Fluentd/rsyslog sample for staging to local collector.
sec-bot: Reminder: create an incident channel for any elevated admin session per runbook https://go/runbooks/temporary-admin
Maya: Pentest flag: kubelet read-only port reachable from management LAN on one customer site. That's why we need network controls in addition to RBAC.
Ashok: Proposed NetworkPolicy to limit control-plane egress to only KMS proxy and metrics collector. Example: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: controlplane-e2-kms-only
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: control-plane
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: onprem-kms-proxy
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/16
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
Jordan: Audit event schema (forward to SIEM): actor, role_granted, reason, expiry, approver, request_id. Example payload: {"actor":"infra/sre-4","role":"infra-admin","approver":"sec-oncall","expiry":"2026-06-12T14:00:00Z","request_id":"INC-12345"}
Ivan (ops): Prevent persistence: automation to revoke role at expiry and scan for active sessions/tokens. Run a job that enumerates grants and active sessions hourly.
Remy: For on-prem HSMs, we can't remote-delete hardware keys. Mitigation: revoke service principal creds, rotate wrapping key (KEK) and update wrapped KEKs in local keystore, then invalidate sessions in access-control service. Add dry-run rotation procedure.
Maya: Proposed gated workflow: 1) Jira approval link required; 2) Create RBAC grant with TTL; 3) Emit structured audit event to SIEM; 4) Apply conservative NetworkPolicy to control-plane/admin tooling; 5) Post-expiry automated reconciliation and short post-mortem.
Ashok: I'll open a PR for RBAC TTL enforcement + audit webhook.
sec-bot: Action created sec/2347 assigned to Ashok ETA 3d.
Jordan: I'll add Fluentd example and audit JSON schema to the docs repo.
Ivan (ops): If suspicious activity reported during session: capture session recordings, revoke grant immediately, collect syslogs, open incident channel, escalate to sec-oncall.
Remy: Also make a note to provide customers a template for KMS wrapping-key rotation with a clear rollback path.
Maya: Sounds good. Once PR lands I'll link the Jira in the runbook and publish the temporary-admin template. :thumbsup:
